metadata.title: Vizzoro | See every material in your space
metadata.description: Let shoppers visualize your flooring, paint, countertops and surfaces in their own space, directly on your website.

hero.title: Let them see the possibility.
hero.subtitle: Bring your catalog into your customers' spaces. Vizzoro turns a room photo into a confident purchase decision, right on your website.
hero.note: No app download · Built for every screen

experience.title: One room. A catalog of new perspectives.
experience.subtitle: Shoppers move from uncertainty to clarity in a few simple moments, without leaving the product page.

steps.title: Capture the space
steps.description: Upload a photo or use a ready-made room. The experience works across phone, tablet and desktop.

steps.title: Understand the surfaces
steps.description: Vizzoro identifies the room geometry and preserves furniture, perspective and natural light.

steps.title: Explore the catalog
steps.description: Apply, compare and save real products from your catalog, then move directly toward a quote or purchase.

materials.title: From a single surface to the whole room.
materials.subtitle: Each material has its own geometry, scale and light. We develop and validate every category independently.

items.title: Flooring
items.description: Planks, tiles and surfaces aligned to the room perspective.

items.title: Paint
items.description: Wall colors that preserve light, shade and architectural detail.

items.title: Countertops
items.description: Stone and engineered surfaces with realistic scale and veining.

items.title: Tile
items.description: Wall and floor tile with pattern, orientation and grout control.

platform.title: Your catalog. Your brand. Your insights.
platform.subtitle: Manage the visual experience without depending on a developer for every update.

items.title: Catalog management

items.title: Website integration
items.description: Authorize your domain, customize the experience and add it to your website with a small snippet.

items.title: Useful analytics

integration.title: A visualizer that feels native to your website.

items.question: Can shoppers use their own photos?
items.answer: Yes. The visualizer is designed for personal room photos and can also offer curated sample rooms for quick exploration.

items.question: Does Vizzoro work with my own catalog?
items.answer: Yes. Your team manages the products, textures, colors and specifications available in the experience.

items.question: Which materials are available?
items.answer: Flooring is the first category entering the pilot. Paint, countertops and tile will be released only after each category reaches its own quality standard.

items.question: Will the visualizer match my website?
items.answer: Yes. Branding, language and calls to action can be configured so the experience feels connected to your store.
